This guide describes the current package structure for contributors. It focuses
on maintained interfaces rather than historical implementation decisions.

## Execution layers

1. The public entry points validate and normalize complete input data.
2. Built-in wrappers choose a `reg_fun` and prepare family-specific data once.
3. `reliever_generic()` constructs the candidate grid and loss cache.
4. The C++ search engine consumes cached interval costs and returns candidate
   segmentations.
5. Result helpers attach run metadata, summaries, plots, and post-fit selection.

Keep whole-data preparation in the outer wrapper. An interval `reg_fun` should
fit and score only the requested rows, apart from methods whose statistical
definition requires a global construction.

## Outer cross-validation

`cv.reliever_generic()` builds ordered folds on the full time axis. Each fold
fits on the remaining observations, evaluates candidate segments on the held-
out observations, aggregates comparable loss positions, and then makes one
full-data fit. Built-in `cv.reliever()` dispatches to this engine after the
family-specific preparation step.

## Generated documentation

Public help pages are generated from roxygen comments in `R/`. Do not edit
files in `man/` directly. After changing a public interface, run:

```r
devtools::document()
```

The pkgdown articles live under `vignettes/articles/` and are excluded from the
CRAN source bundle. GitHub Actions builds the website into a deployment
artifact; generated HTML is not committed to the repository.

## Test modes

The default test mode is `quick`. Set `RELIEVER_TEST_MODE` before running tests
to include additional suites:

| Value | Additional coverage |
| --- | --- |
| `quick` | Default package tests |
| `full` | Longer accuracy and wrapper-equivalence tests |
| `interval` | Relief-interval suite |
| `all` | Both full and interval suites |

For example, from PowerShell:

```powershell
$env:RELIEVER_TEST_MODE = "full"
& "D:\Program_Files\R-4.6.1\bin\R.exe" CMD test .
```

Before release, build the source archive and run `R CMD check --as-cran` on the
archive rather than only checking the source directory.
